editorial:
Imagine coming home from school and finding out your life has completely changed because of a mysterious mark on your skin. You follow a struggling 13-year-old girl and her hardworking single mom who are just trying to get by. Everything seems normal until the girl shows up with a strange tattoo that she didn't have before. From that moment, the movie shifts from a sad family story into a scary ride. You will feel the tension grow as the girl starts changing in ways that are hard to explain, and you'll wonder if she is still the same person or something totally different.

The acting is top-notch and makes the scary parts feel real. While the middle of the movie slows down a bit, the ending hits hard with some wild twists you won't see coming. If you like stories that mix family drama with creepy sci-fi, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The final scenes reveal that the tattoo is actually a biological tracker for an alien species. The girl isn't just sick; she is being turned into a host for a new creature. In a shocking twist, the mother tries to save her, but the transformation finishes. The movie ends with the girl fully changing and leaving her mother behind to start a new colony on Earth, leaving you with a scary feeling that more are coming.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird sci-fi and scary body horror.
